force.description: If true, changes from Pkg.Store will overwrite the remote branch that is configured.

newBranch.description:
For publishing changes to a different branch than configured, specifiy this.  The new branch will be created with
changes from Pkg.Store. Will throw error if branch already exists and force is not set.
Note: Configured branch will not change.

onConflictCreatePr.description:
When commiting changes, local changes are applied on latest remote branch ( git rebase), if there are conflicts,
and onConflictCreatePr is set, a temp branch and a GitHub PullRequest with changes will be created for users to
resolve externally and merge to configured branch. ( pullFromGit with reset to update Pkg.Store.)

title: Spec to be used for Pkg.Store git operations.
